fields.description: When ticked, the Google Drive backup (Integrations → Google Drive, scheduled or "Take Backup") uploads the files archive without the gallery folder public/files/es_photos (uploaded originals and their resized copies). Database, other files and other backups (local bench backups, S3, Dropbox) are unchanged. Back the gallery folder up some other way if you need a copy.

fields.label: Gallery storage
fields.options:
Where gallery files live
sites/<site>/public/files/es_photos/originals/ — uploaded originals
sites/<site>/public/files/es_photos/ — thumb / medium / large copies

To keep a copy of the gallery outside Google Drive, back up that folder, e.g.
rsync -a sites/<site>/public/files/es_photos/ /backup/es_photos/
